name: Transgressive Memory Festival
description: The eCommemoration Transgressive Memory Festival opens a space for forms of remembrance that connect past and present, contemporary art and digital culture. What happens when memory is no longer anchored only in archives and institutional rituals, but is renegotiated through digital media, artistic practices, and performative formats? The festival explores how memory is transformed and questioned through contemporary cultural production, offering new approaches to collective and personal histories.
